mapper.select: select PTL_FEE_TYPE ptlFeeType, TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE tdyAccumulPayFee from PTL_FEE_POSITION where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and 1 = to_date(#{cdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') - CDATE and PTL_FEE_TYPE IN (#{feeType_ALT0102}, #{feeType_ALT0202}, #{feeType_ALT0302}, #{feeType_TAX0102}, #{feeType_TAX0202}, #{feeType_TAX0302})
select PAY_CYCLE from ( SELECT row_number() over() as ROWNUM,PAY_CYCLE FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId} and eff_date <= to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) where ROWNUM <= 1

select dat.resiPrincipal from ( select row_number() over() as rownum, psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_CASH_POSITION psp
where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and psp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_CASH_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) order by psp.CDATE desc )dat where rownum = 1
